name: rocketchat
description: Rocket.Chat (MongoDB): db_autodetect is OFF - MongoDB is not a SQL database, and mongodump cannot be relied on inside the official mongo image (the database tools were split out with 4.4). Consistency comes from the BUILT-IN quiesce instead: docker-backup detects the mongo service and freezes writes via db.fsyncLock ONLY around the file capture (named volume -> only during the tar step, before the restic upload), releasing in a finally. Reads keep working, no downtime, no --allow-hooks needed. Should the lock ever remain stuck after a hard abort, restarting the mongo container releases it.
